title: Deep link to route
summary: Match a deep link URL against path patterns and return the screen and params.
prompt: Write `parseDeepLink(url, config)`. `config.prefixes` lists accepted prefixes such as `shop://` and `https://shop.example/`. `config.screens` maps screen names to patterns such as `product/:id`. Strip a matching prefix (return `null` if none matches), split off the query string, and match the path segment by segment (ignore leading, trailing and repeated slashes). `:name` segments capture a URI-decoded param; other segments must match exactly. Query params (decoded, `+` as space) are merged in, but path params win on conflict. Return `{ screen, params }` for the first screen in config order that matches, or `null`. An empty path matches the pattern `''`. There is no React Native runtime here, so this is modelled as plain TypeScript.
